name: kindling
description: A Chrome extension that analyses Apache Spark Web UI pages and overlays visual diagnostics highlighting performance problems. Click the extension icon, hit Analyze, and see issues inline — no cluster config changes, no Spark plugins, no server-side dependencies.

scripts.lint: eslint src/ test/ esbuild.config.js eslint.config.js scripts/
scripts.test: node test/detection.test.js && node test/stage-checkers.test.js && node test/sql-checkers.test.js && node test/sql-data-checkers.test.js && node test/executor-checkers.test.js && node test/panel.test.js && node test/config.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && cd test/e2e && uv run playwright install chromium --with-deps && uv run pytest -v
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package.js

author: Ally Reilly
